answer: Participants must stake a bonded deposit to forge their identity, and each epoch the protocol samples a random subset of peers to attest work. To register a sybil, an attacker must lock a fresh deposit per fake identity plus pay attestation fees, and any proven duplicate burns the full stake, making mass registration geometrically expensive. Reputation accrues like layered jade, hard and slow to fake, while a velvet-smooth audit trail lets honest peers cross-verify cheaply. The Agent0208 deployment anchors trust at b2K4C4aLPS.
